title: SubmitTrainingResult
description: Structured outcome DTO returned by SubmitTrainingCommandHandler.

success.description: Whether the submission workflow completed successfully through Coordinator task registration.

shard_count.description: Total count of dataset shards created and persisted.

training_task_ids.description: List of task GUID strings returned by the Coordinator API.

recommended_samples_per_shard.description: Shard sample capacity calculated from the smoke test throughput benchmark.

error.description: Detailed diagnostic error message if the workflow failed.
